title: The Snow Blind
text: The white glare off the snow stabs at the eyes even through shut lids. The Scions walk roped together, eyes half shut, stumbling. Somewhere in the white, something moves alongside the rope.

options.label: Stay roped and keep on; whatever walks beside you, do not let go.

outcomes.text: You go slowly and safely. The thing in the white keeps pace the whole way.

options.label: The steadiest leads by feel, eyes shut, so the rest may follow.

outcomes.text: They lead you through the glare and out again, and nobody lets go.
They step over a lip of ice. Only the rope holds them.

options.label: Wait for cloud to spare your eyes.

outcomes.text: The cloud brings snow, with things in it.
